title: MACHINE_STATE value
description: Value at KV bucket MACHINE_STATE, key <machine_id>. Machine-specific fields are merged at top level.

timestamp.description: UTC, ISO 8601. Reference implementations emit second precision: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

protocol_version.description: Edge Protocol version (MAJOR.MINOR) of the edge that wrote this value (spec §10). Absent in values written before it was added; readers MUST NOT require it.
